2125912575804047852.en_summary: The Nasdaq-100 is cheaper on forward earnings today than at the bottom of the dot-com crash. Forward P/E is 17x right now, the lowest in four years. At October 2002 bottom after 83% fall, forward P/E was still 20-25x. Index stands 32 times higher than that bottom and cheaper on earnings. 2002 multiple sat on collapsed earnings so never actually cheap. Today's ~17x sits on real and still growing earnings. Tech premium has vanished, Nasdaq-100 now trades at roughly same forward multiple as S&P 500. Cheap does not mean selling is over, tape still has to confirm the turn. Valuation case for Nasdaq has not been this strong since last bottom.
2125912575804047852.zh_summary: 納斯達克100指數目前的遠期盈利估值比互聯網泡沫底部更便宜。目前遠期市盈率為17倍，是四年來最低。2002年10月底部在下跌83%後，遠期市盈率仍為20-25倍。指數比該底部高出32倍，但盈利更便宜。2002年的倍數建立在已崩潰的盈利上，所以實際上並不便宜。今天的約17倍建立在真實且仍在增長的盈利上。科技溢價已消失，納斯達克100現在與標普500的遠期倍數大致相同。便宜並不意味著拋售結束，市場仍需確認轉折。納斯達克的估值理由自上次底部以來從未如此強勁。
